WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
),
shares AS (
  SELECT circuitId,
         race_count,
         1.0 * race_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS race_share,
         1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT circuitId) FROM races) AS average_share
  FROM circuit_counts
)
SELECT circuitId,
       race_count,
       race_share,
       race_share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM shares
ORDER BY above_average_share DESC
LIMIT 10;
